name: OKR Cycle Summary
query: select c.name as cycle, c.cycle_name, c.company, c.start_date, c.end_date, c.status, round(avg(o.progress), 2) as average_objective_progress, round(avg(k.target_progress), 2) as average_key_result_progress from `tabOKR Cycle` c left join `tabOKR Objective` o on o.cycle = c.name left join `tabOKR Key Result` k on k.cycle = c.name group by c.name, c.cycle_name, c.company, c.start_date, c.end_date, c.status order by c.modified desc
